chats.answer:
For a 12V all-in-one solar inverter charger, my top brands to consider are EG4, Renogy, and MPP Solar, depending on your budget and power requirements.

I'm assuming you want a single unit that combines:

Pure sine wave inverter (12V DC → 120V AC)

MPPT solar charge controller

AC battery charger (shore power or generator)

Automatic switching between solar, battery, and AC power

Support for 12V LiFePO4 batteries

One important consideration: 12V all-in-one units are less common than 24V and 48V models. For systems above roughly 2,000W, a 24V or 48V battery system is usually more practical because it reduces DC current.

Important considerations

For a 3000W inverter on a 12V battery system, expect approximately 280A of DC current at full output, depending on efficiency and battery voltage. That requires a capable battery bank, appropriately rated BMS, large cables and proper overcurrent protection.
